record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, retain pointwise positive-plus-negative logistic loss but average valid positions within each sampled sequence first, then average sequences, instead of averaging globally over positions. Equal sequence weighting may prevent longer histories from dominating updates and better match user-averaged HR@10. Preserve sampling, features, embeddings, architecture, scoring/readout, optimizer, scheduler and batch/epoch settings.
